question.text: As per SEBI Circular dated July 31, 2025, the Digital Platforms provided by AIFs to their investors shall be:

answer.text: Compliant with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and corresponding rules.
Available only in English language on a nationally hosted server.
Restricted to domestic resident investors only.
Audited by a SEBI-registered cyber-security firm quarterly.

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI Circular No.: SEBI/HO/ITD-1/ITD_VIAP/P/CIR/2025/111 dated July 31, 2025 mandates that all Digital Platforms provided by AIFs to their investors shall be compliant with the provisions of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (RPwD Act) and corresponding rules. The objective is to facilitate increased participation of persons with disabilities in the securities markets. The Trap: Options B, C, D invent plausible but non-existent requirements (language-only, residence-only, audit-cadence rules). Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests this recent circular. Not a feature of older curriculum in XIX-B/XIX-D depending on version. Manager's Pro-Tip: Audit your investor portal against WCAG 2.1 AA benchmarks as a proxy for RPwD compliance (screen-reader tags, keyboard navigation, colour-contrast ratios, alt-text on charts). Add accessibility audit to annual IT-review scope — cheaper to fix in-design than post-launch.
